cases.label: 모두 시작하되 완료 역전에도 입력 순서로 집계
cases.probe: let releaseA,releaseB;const a=new Promise(resolve=>{releaseA=resolve;});const b=new Promise(resolve=>{releaseB=resolve;});const starts=[];let startedA,startedB;const signalA=new Promise(resolve=>{startedA=resolve;});const signalB=new Promise(resolve=>{startedB=resolve;});const pending=Promise.resolve(submission.aggregateQueries([()=>{starts.push('a');startedA();return a;},()=>{starts.push('b');startedB();return b;}]));await Promise.race([Promise.all([signalA,signalB]),pending.then(()=>false,()=>false)]);const started=starts.slice();releaseB('B');await Promise.resolve();releaseA('A');observe({started,result:await pending});

cases.label: settled는 부분 실패를 입력 순서로 보존
first는 먼저 거부된 작업 뒤에도 성공을 기다린다
전부 실패하면 AggregateError.errors는 입력 순서
cases.probe: let rejectA,rejectB;const a=new Promise((_,reject)=>{rejectA=reject;});const b=new Promise((_,reject)=>{rejectB=reject;});void a.catch(()=>{});void b.catch(()=>{});const pending=submission.aggregateQueries([()=>a,()=>b],'first');const observed=pending.then(value=>({value}),error=>({isAggregate:error instanceof AggregateError,name:error.name,errors:error.errors}));await Promise.resolve();await Promise.resolve();rejectB('B');await Promise.resolve();rejectA('A');observe(await observed);

cases.label: race는 최초 완료의 성공 또는 실패를 전달
빈 입력의 세 표준 동작과 래퍼 race 정책
race 완료 후에도 나머지 작업은 계속될 수 있다
cases.probe: let finish;const late=new Promise(resolve=>{finish=resolve;});const events=[];const winner=await submission.aggregateQueries([()=>{events.push('fast-start');return 'fast';},()=>{events.push('slow-start');return late.then(value=>{events.push('slow-done');return value;});}],'race');finish('slow');await late;await Promise.resolve();observe({winner,events});

cases.label: 빈 슬롯과 상속 요소는 실행 전에 거부
cases.probe: let calls=0;const task=()=>{calls++;return 1;};const sparse=[task,,task];const inherited=[task,,task];const prototype=Object.create(Array.prototype);prototype[1]=task;Object.setPrototypeOf(inherited,prototype);const errors=[];for(const tasks of [sparse,inherited]){try{await submission.aggregateQueries(tasks);errors.push(false);}catch(error){errors.push(error instanceof TypeError);}}observe({calls,errors});
